collection.title: KIA Cee'd Sports Wagon 2009 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The KIA Cee'd Sporty Wagon 2009 to 2011 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, we also have rear blade for this Cee'd Sporty Wagon, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
